profile.headline: Software Engineer | Infrastructure, Platform, & Reliability | Observability & Automation
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer focused on infrastructure, platform, and reliability work: making systems easier to observe, safer to ship, and faster to recover when something breaks.

At JetBlue, I own the shared observability library behind JetBlue.com (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki), lead the engineering observability guild, and build the alerting and runbooks for the Jetblue.com homepage that have caught several high-revenue-impact production failures. I also automate release workflows via Github Actions across shared libraries and assisted on Docker/Kubernetes deployments with Terraform and Helm.

Before JetBlue, I built and deployed containerized ML pipelines at Lennar and an AI/ML SDK supporting GenAI use cases in pharma R&D at Johnson & Johnson, which gave me a strong foundation in production data and ML systems.

As AI speeds up how fast software gets written and shipped, I think the guardrails matter more than ever: strong observability, safe releases, and systems that fail loudly instead of silently. That's the work I care about.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead the engineering observability guild; presented observability work at an engineering showcase with the CTO. 
• Own shared Node.js observability for JetBlue.com with Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 
• Built alerts and runbooks that cut stale-content detection from 7 days to 6 hours and provided 21-minute advance warning of a homepage outage (six-figure revenue exposure and hundreds of bookings in a comparable window).
• Led BFF route architecture for JetBlue.com, keeping API subscription keys server-side with Azure Key Vault; delivered calendar fare APIs and React integration. 
• Automated package versioning, Artifactory publishing, and release notifications using GitHub Actions, pnpm, and Changesets across shared engineering libraries.
• Built a durable outage fallback on Fastly and Azure Blob Storage; contributed to Docker/Kubernetes deployment configuration with Terraform and Helm chart updates.
• Use AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Codex) to accelerate coding, debugging, and documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Docker · Kubernetes · Github Actions · Grafana · Software Infrastructure · Platform Architecture · Cloud Infrastructure · Cloud Services · Production Deployment · Server Architecture · Reliability Engineering

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
• Led migration, enhancement, and deployment of containerized, cloud-native anomaly detection ML pipeline using Python, Prefect, Docker, and Kubernetes, integrating Snowflake, Pandas, and NumPy for advanced time-series forecasting and real-time Slack alerts
• Collaborated with data scientists to optimize and refactor ML code for efficiency and scalability for production use cases, while partnering with DevOps to enhance infrastructure performance
positions.insights: Skills: Python · MLOps · Software Development · Machine Learning · Prefect · Microsoft Azure · Kubernetes · Pandas · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: New Brunswick, New Jersey, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Senior Software Developer, J&J Technology

• Led enhancement of an AI/ML SDK using Python and GraphQL to enable event-driven and serverless architectures for AI/GenAI-based Pharma R&D use cases. 
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement modular SDK components, including DAG builder tooling, external tool integration, and API modules for a critical AI/ML project's automation pipeline. 
• Contributed ideas for robust and flexible architecture in software design workshops and discussions.

• Led full-stack development of identity access management portal for external users, using ReactJS, Node.js, HTML, and CSS.

Software Engineer, Medical Devices

• Developed Python data ingestion application used in production for medical device research teams.
• Created Python code, PostgreSQL database schemas, and delivered automated data migrations and ORM via Alembic and SQLAlchemy.
• Developed cloud infrastructure using Docker & Kubernetes, and delivered 90% code coverage via PyTest.
• Provided peer support in development, code reviews, and onboarding, utilizing Bitbucket and JIRA.

Data Science & Analytics, Janssen Data Science

• Performed ETL development and programming of patient data using AWS Redshift, SQL & Python, focusing on scale, quality, and best practices.
• Developed Tableau dashboards and reports to provide high-value information for effective strategic decision-making.
